extraction.text:
Avantika Yadav

Adobe Certified Workfront & Fusion Developer | SaaS & API Integrations.

Email: avantikayadav108@gmail.com | +91-9083174447 | Noida, India LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/avantika-yadav-492234183

Summary Workfront Developer with 4 years of experience specializing in Adobe Workfront administration, Fusion integrations, and API- based automation. I design scalable workflows, custom forms, and dashboards to optimize resource management and governance. Expert in SSO, role-based access control, and data analysis via Power BI, I bridge the gap between technical solutions and stakeholder needs to drive business efficiency.

Professional Experience

Workfront Developer Labcorp, Bangalore | March 2025 – Present

Implement, Onboard, Administer and support the Adobe Workfront platform, enabling project and portfolio management across global teams. - Configure Workfront workflows, custom forms, reports, and dashboards to streamline project tracking and enhance visibility for leadership teams.

Support and maintain Workfront Fusion integrations and troubleshoot APIs to ensure seamless data flow across enterprise applications.

Implement and manage Workfront user provisioning, roles, and permissions to maintain security and compliance. - Collaborate with stakeholders to design scalable solutions, optimize existing processes, and improve adoption of Workfront features.

Deliver training sessions and documentation to empower business users and improve self-service.

Key Contributions: - Automated approval workflows through Fusion, reducing manual tasks by 30%. - Designed scalable reporting dashboards, improving real-time decision-making for project managers. - Enhanced governance by streamlining role-based access control and SSO setup in Workfront.

Workfront Administrator Piramal Finance, Noida | September 2024 – March 2025



•





Supported the administration and optimization of Adobe Workfront, ensuring platform stability and user efficiency across departments. - Managed user provisioning, access roles, and permissions, maintaining governance and data security standards. - Configured custom forms, reports, and dashboards to enhance visibility and process automation for project and resource management. - Assisted in maintaining Workfront integrations with Azure and other enterprise tools, resolving API and synchronization issues. - Collaborated with business teams to capture requirements and streamline workflows, ensuring consistent adherence to organizational standards.

Key Contributions:

Improved reporting accuracy by standardizing custom form configurations and reducing manual data entry.

Strengthened platform governance through structured user access and audit-ready documentation.

Workfront Support Engineer Adobe, Noida | June 2023 – August 2024

Delivered expert technical support for Adobe Workfront, assisting enterprise customers with project management, workflow automation, and resource planning.

Resolved issues related to custom forms, Fusion automation, API integrations, and reporting dashboards. - Configured Workfront SSO authentication, user roles, and security policies for smooth enterprise adoption. - Conducted product training, onboarding, and best practices workshops, driving Workfront adoption and retention. - Partnered with engineering and product teams to escalate and resolve recurring issues.

Key Project: - Workfront Migration to Adobe Admin Console: Led the customer migration process, ensuring smooth transition, rolemapping

accuracy, and minimal downtime.

Technical Support Executive Benchmark, Gurugram | February 2022 – May 2023

Supported cloud-based SaaS applications and assisted in Workfront-related administrative tasks, including user setup, permissions management, and minor workflow maintenance.

Provided customer assistance with API troubleshooting, workflow automation, and data sync issues across multiple systems.

Helped maintain Workfront documentation and reporting templates, contributing to improved internal efficiency and user experience.

Supported email deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and managed integrations between various platforms.

Utilized Zendesk, Jira, and Power BI to track, analyze, and optimize support performance.

Key Contributions:

Improved Workfront ticket resolution turnaround by standardizing escalation and documentation processes.

Enhanced SaaS operational visibility by developing reusable reporting dashboards and automation checks.

Education Bachelor of Science in Information Technology Dev Bhoomi Uttarakhand University | July 2019 – August 2022

Technical Skills - Workfront Expertise: Workfront Administration, Fusion Integrations, Reporting & Dashboards, Custom Forms, User

Provisioning & Access Control

SaaS & Cloud: Azure, SaaS Application Support - Data & Automation: SQL Queries, Power BI, Zapier - Support Tools: Zendesk, Jira, MS Dynamics, Salesforce, Symphony Summit, Freshworks - Networking & Security: SSO, Active Directory, VPN, Authentication Protocols - Database Management: SQL

Core Competencies - Adobe Workfront Development & Administration - Workfront Fusion Automation & API Integrations - Workflow Optimization & Process Automation - Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution - Customer Training & Technical Documentation
